description: For every failed LC deduction \(\Gamma\not\vdash_{\mathcal L}A\), take the actual canonical counterworld \(P=\mathsf E(\Gamma\cup\mathcal L,A)\). The specified generated model \((\mathcal C_{\mathcal L})_{\geq P}\) remains a countermodel at \(P\), has \(P\) as its least world, and its inclusion order is linear.
